question: For each team with active members, who is the active member responsible for the most accounts? Include members with no accounts, show team names, member names and account counts, and break ties using the lowest user ID.
gold_sql: WITH cte1 AS (SELECT T1.team_id AS c1, T1.name AS c2, T2.user_id AS c3, T2.full_name AS c4, COUNT(T3.account_id) AS c5 FROM teams AS T1 JOIN users AS T2 ON T2.team_id = T1.team_id AND T2.tenant_id = :tenant_id AND T2.is_active = 1 LEFT JOIN accounts AS T3 ON T3.owner_user_id = T2.user_id AND T3.tenant_id = :tenant_id WHERE T1.tenant_id = :tenant_id GROUP BY T1.team_id, T1.name, T2.user_id, T2.full_name) SELECT T1.c2, T1.c4, T1.c5 FROM cte1 AS T1 WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cte1 AS T2 WHERE T2.c1 = T1.c1 AND (T2.c5 > T1.c5 OR (T2.c5 = T1.c5 AND T2.c3 < T1.c3))) LIMIT 100

question: For each quarter from Q1 through Q3 2026, what was the average resolution time in hours for tickets assigned to Travis Baird or Brandon Kirby and resolved during that quarter? Show each agent separately, include partial hours and round averages to two decimals.
gold_sql: WITH cte1 AS (SELECT 'Q1 2026' AS c1, '2026-01-01' AS c2, '2026-04-01' AS c3 UNION ALL SELECT 'Q2 2026' AS c1, '2026-04-01' AS c2, '2026-07-01' AS c3 UNION ALL SELECT 'Q3 2026' AS c1, '2026-07-01' AS c2, '2026-10-01' AS c3) SELECT T1.c1, T2.full_name, ROUND(AVG((JULIANDAY(T3.resolved_at) - JULIANDAY(T3.opened_at)) * 24.0), 2) AS c4 FROM cte1 AS T1 CROSS JOIN users AS T2 LEFT JOIN tickets AS T3 ON T3.owner_user_id = T2.user_id AND T3.tenant_id = :tenant_id AND JULIANDAY(T3.resolved_at) >= JULIANDAY(T1.c2) AND JULIANDAY(T3.resolved_at) < JULIANDAY(T1.c3) WHERE T2.tenant_id = :tenant_id AND LOWER(T2.full_name) IN ('travis baird', 'brandon kirby') GROUP BY T1.c1, T2.user_id, T2.full_name ORDER BY T1.c1, T2.full_name LIMIT 100

question: As of 2026-09-30, which 10 open invoices were the most days overdue? Treat an invoice as overdue only if its due date was before 2026-09-30. Show the invoice number, account, due date in YYYY-MM-DD format and whole days overdue. Break ties by invoice ID.
gold_sql: WITH cte1 AS (SELECT T1.invoice_id, T1.invoice_number, T2.name, CASE WHEN INSTR(T1.due_date, '/') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(T1.due_date, 7, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(T1.due_date, 1, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(T1.due_date, 4, 2) ELSE T1.due_date END AS c1 FROM invoices AS T1 JOIN accounts AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id AND T2.tenant_id = :tenant_id WHERE T1.tenant_id = :tenant_id AND LOWER(T1.status) = 'open') SELECT T1.invoice_number, T1.name, T1.c1, CAST(JULIANDAY('2026-09-30') - JULIANDAY(T1.c1) AS INTEGER) AS c2 FROM cte1 AS T1 WHERE T1.c1 < '2026-09-30' ORDER BY c2 DESC, T1.invoice_id ASC LIMIT 10

question: For our open AUD invoices overdue as of 2026-09-30, how much was invoiced in each aging band: 1–30, 31–60, 61–90 and more than 90 days overdue? Use the full invoice totals, include tax and round amounts to two decimals.
gold_sql: WITH cte1 AS (SELECT JULIANDAY('2026-09-30') - JULIANDAY(CASE WHEN INSTR(T1.due_date, '/') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(T1.due_date, 7, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(T1.due_date, 1, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(T1.due_date, 4, 2) ELSE T1.due_date END) AS c1, T1.total_amount AS c2 FROM invoices AS T1 WHERE T1.tenant_id = :tenant_id AND LOWER(T1.status) = 'open' AND LOWER(T1.currency_code) = 'aud'), cte2 AS (SELECT 1 AS c1, 30 AS c2, '1–30' AS c3 UNION ALL SELECT 31, 60, '31–60' UNION ALL SELECT 61, 90, '61–90' UNION ALL SELECT 91, NULL, 'more than 90') SELECT T2.c3, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(T1.c2), 0), 2) AS c1 FROM cte2 AS T2 LEFT JOIN cte1 AS T1 ON T1.c1 >= T2.c1 AND (T1.c1 <= T2.c2 OR T2.c2 IS NULL) GROUP BY T2.c1, T2.c3 ORDER BY T2.c1 LIMIT 100

question: For each month from January through September 2026, what was the average number of days from invoice issue to the first successful payment, for invoices whose first successful payment occurred in that month? Measure using calendar dates and round averages to two decimals.
gold_sql: WITH cte1 AS (SELECT T1.invoice_id, MIN(DATE(T1.paid_at)) AS c1 FROM payments AS T1 WHERE T1.tenant_id = :tenant_id AND LOWER(T1.status) = 'succeeded' GROUP BY T1.invoice_id), cte2 AS (SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-%m', T1.c1) AS c1, ROUND(AVG(JULIANDAY(T1.c1) - JULIANDAY(DATE(T2.issued_at))), 2) AS c2 FROM cte1 AS T1 JOIN invoices AS T2 ON T2.invoice_id = T1.invoice_id AND T2.tenant_id = :tenant_id WHERE T1.c1 >= '2026-01-01' AND T1.c1 < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY STRFTIME('%Y-%m', T1.c1)), cte3 AS (SELECT '2026-01' AS c1 UNION ALL SELECT '2026-02' UNION ALL SELECT '2026-03' UNION ALL SELECT '2026-04' UNION ALL SELECT '2026-05' UNION ALL SELECT '2026-06' UNION ALL SELECT '2026-07' UNION ALL SELECT '2026-08' UNION ALL SELECT '2026-09') SELECT T1.c1, T2.c2 FROM cte3 AS T1 LEFT JOIN cte2 AS T2 ON T2.c1 = T1.c1 ORDER BY T1.c1 LIMIT 100

question: Which 10 canceled subscriptions that ended between 2026-01-01 and 2026-09-30 lasted the longest from start date to cancellation date? Show the subscription ID, account, plan and duration in whole days. Break ties by subscription ID.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.subscription_id, T2.name, T3.name, CAST(JULIANDAY(T1.canceled_at) - JULIANDAY(T1.started_at) AS INTEGER) AS c1 FROM subscriptions AS T1 JOIN accounts AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id AND T2.tenant_id = :tenant_id JOIN plans AS T3 ON T1.plan_id = T3.plan_id WHERE T1.tenant_id = :tenant_id AND LOWER(T1.status) = 'canceled' AND T1.canceled_at BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-09-30' ORDER BY c1 DESC, T1.subscription_id ASC LIMIT 10

question: For invoices issued in Q2 2026, what were the total amount billed and total tax in USD for each customer country, including a separate group for unknown countries? Use our fixed reporting rates, round both amounts to two decimals, and show the top 10 countries by amount billed, breaking ties by country code.
gold_sql: SELECT COALESCE(T3.name, 'Unknown') AS c1, ROUND(SUM(T1.total_amount * T4.usd_rate), 2) AS c2, ROUND(SUM(T1.tax * T4.usd_rate), 2) AS c3 FROM invoices AS T1 JOIN accounts AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id AND T2.tenant_id = :tenant_id LEFT JOIN countries AS T3 ON T2.country_code = T3.country_code JOIN currencies AS T4 ON T1.currency_code = T4.currency_code WHERE T1.tenant_id = :tenant_id AND T1.issued_at >= '2026-04-01' AND T1.issued_at < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY T3.country_code, T3.name ORDER BY SUM(T1.total_amount * T4.usd_rate) DESC, T3.country_code ASC LIMIT 10

question: Which 10 open invoices had the largest unpaid balances as of 2026-09-30, counting only successful payments made through that date? Show the invoice number, account, and remaining balance in USD at our fixed reporting rates, rounded to two decimals. Exclude zero or negative balances and break ties by invoice ID.
gold_sql: WITH cte1 AS (SELECT T1.invoice_id, SUM(T1.amount) / 100.0 AS c1 FROM payments AS T1 WHERE T1.tenant_id = :tenant_id AND LOWER(T1.status) = 'succeeded' AND T1.paid_at < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY T1.invoice_id) SELECT T1.invoice_number, T2.name, ROUND((T1.total_amount - COALESCE(T4.c1, 0)) * T3.usd_rate, 2) AS c1 FROM invoices AS T1 JOIN accounts AS T2 ON T2.account_id = T1.account_id AND T2.tenant_id = :tenant_id JOIN currencies AS T3 ON T3.currency_code = T1.currency_code LEFT JOIN cte1 AS T4 ON T4.invoice_id = T1.invoice_id WHERE T1.tenant_id = :tenant_id AND LOWER(T1.status) = 'open' AND T1.issued_at <= '2026-09-30' AND T1.total_amount - COALESCE(T4.c1, 0) > 0 ORDER BY (T1.total_amount - COALESCE(T4.c1, 0)) * T3.usd_rate DESC, T1.invoice_id ASC LIMIT 10

question: Which 10 active subscriptions have the largest monthly discount savings at USD list prices? Calculate savings from seats and discount percentage, divide annual-plan savings by 12, and show the account, plan, seats, and monthly savings rounded to two decimals. Break ties by subscription ID.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.name, T3.name, T1.seats, ROUND(T1.seats * T3.price_per_seat * T1.discount_pct / 100.0 / CASE WHEN LOWER(T3.billing_period) = 'annual' THEN 12.0 ELSE 1.0 END, 2) AS c1 FROM subscriptions AS T1 JOIN accounts AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id AND T2.tenant_id = :tenant_id JOIN plans AS T3 ON T1.plan_id = T3.plan_id WHERE T1.tenant_id = :tenant_id AND LOWER(T1.status) = 'active' ORDER BY T1.seats * T3.price_per_seat * T1.discount_pct / 100.0 / CASE WHEN LOWER(T3.billing_period) = 'annual' THEN 12.0 ELSE 1.0 END DESC, T1.subscription_id ASC LIMIT 10

question: Which 10 accounts had the most tax billed on non-void invoices issued in 2025 while based in the same country as us? Show each account's tax total in USD using our fixed reporting rates, rounded to two decimals, and break ties by account ID.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.name, ROUND(SUM(T2.tax * T4.usd_rate), 2) AS c1 FROM accounts AS T1 JOIN invoices AS T2 ON T2.account_id = T1.account_id AND T2.tenant_id = :tenant_id JOIN tenants AS T3 ON T3.country_code = T1.country_code AND T3.tenant_id = :tenant_id JOIN currencies AS T4 ON T4.currency_code = T2.currency_code WHERE T1.tenant_id = :tenant_id AND LOWER(T2.status) <> 'void' AND T2.issued_at >= '2025-01-01' AND T2.issued_at < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY T1.account_id, T1.name ORDER BY SUM(T2.tax * T4.usd_rate) DESC, T1.account_id ASC LIMIT 10

question: Which 10 accounts received the largest discount credits on invoices issued in 2025? Treat negative line totals on non-void invoices as discount credits, report their combined magnitude as a positive USD amount using our fixed reporting rates, round to two decimals, and break ties by account ID.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.name, ROUND(SUM(-T3.line_total * T4.usd_rate), 2) AS c1 FROM accounts AS T1 JOIN invoices AS T2 ON T2.account_id = T1.account_id AND T2.tenant_id = :tenant_id JOIN invoice_line_items AS T3 ON T3.invoice_id = T2.invoice_id AND T3.tenant_id = :tenant_id JOIN currencies AS T4 ON T4.currency_code = T2.currency_code WHERE T1.tenant_id = :tenant_id AND T2.issued_at >= '2025-01-01' AND T2.issued_at < '2026-01-01' AND LOWER(T2.status) <> 'void' AND T3.line_total < 0 GROUP BY T1.account_id, T1.name ORDER BY SUM(-T3.line_total * T4.usd_rate) DESC, T1.account_id ASC LIMIT 10

question: Which 10 accounts with a primary contact whose email is missing had the largest total billed on non-void invoices issued in 2026 through September 30? Show the account, primary contact's name, and total billed in USD using our fixed reporting rates, rounded to two decimals. Break ties by account ID.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.name, T2.first_name || ' ' || T2.last_name AS c1, ROUND(SUM(T3.total_amount * T4.usd_rate), 2) AS c2 FROM accounts AS T1 JOIN contacts AS T2 ON T2.account_id = T1.account_id AND T2.tenant_id = :tenant_id JOIN invoices AS T3 ON T3.account_id = T1.account_id AND T3.tenant_id = :tenant_id JOIN currencies AS T4 ON T4.currency_code = T3.currency_code WHERE T1.tenant_id = :tenant_id AND T2.is_primary = 1 AND T2.email IS NULL AND LOWER(T3.status) <> 'void' AND T3.issued_at >= '2026-01-01' AND T3.issued_at < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY T1.account_id, T1.name, T2.contact_id, T2.first_name, T2.last_name ORDER BY SUM(T3.total_amount * T4.usd_rate) DESC, T1.account_id ASC LIMIT 10

question: For Sales East, Sales West and Enterprise Sales, what was the total first-year value of deals actually won in Q2 2026, converted to USD using our fixed reporting rates? Attribute deals to their owners' teams, include teams with no wins as zero, and round totals to two decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.name, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(T3.amount * T4.usd_rate), 0), 2) AS c1 FROM teams AS T1 LEFT JOIN users AS T2 ON T2.team_id = T1.team_id AND T2.tenant_id = :tenant_id LEFT JOIN deals AS T3 ON T3.owner_user_id = T2.user_id AND T3.tenant_id = :tenant_id AND LOWER(T3.stage) = 'closed_won' AND T3.closed_at >= '2026-04-01' AND T3.closed_at < '2026-07-01' LEFT JOIN currencies AS T4 ON T4.currency_code = T3.currency_code WHERE T1.tenant_id = :tenant_id AND LOWER(T1.name) IN ('sales east', 'sales west', 'enterprise sales') GROUP BY T1.team_id, T1.name LIMIT 100

question: For each Support team agent who resolved at least five tickets opened in Q1 2026, what was the average time from opening to resolution in hours? Use tickets with a recorded resolution time, attribute them to their assigned agent, and round averages to two decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.full_name, ROUND(AVG((JULIANDAY(T3.resolved_at) - JULIANDAY(T3.opened_at)) * 24.0), 2) AS c1 FROM users AS T1 JOIN teams AS T2 ON T1.team_id = T2.team_id AND T2.tenant_id = :tenant_id JOIN tickets AS T3 ON T3.owner_user_id = T1.user_id AND T3.tenant_id = :tenant_id WHERE T1.tenant_id = :tenant_id AND LOWER(T2.department) = 'support' AND LOWER(T1.role) = 'support_agent' AND T3.resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND JULIANDAY(T3.opened_at) >= JULIANDAY('2026-01-01') AND JULIANDAY(T3.opened_at) < JULIANDAY('2026-04-01') GROUP BY T1.user_id, T1.full_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 LIMIT 100

question: How many customer accounts in our headquarters country have at least one subscription currently marked active on an enterprise-tier plan? Ignore casing in the customer designation and count each account only once.
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS c1 FROM accounts AS T1 JOIN tenants AS T2 ON T1.country_code = T2.country_code AND T2.tenant_id = :tenant_id WHERE T1.tenant_id = :tenant_id AND LOWER(T1.lifecycle_stage) = 'customer' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM subscriptions AS T3 JOIN plans AS T4 ON T3.plan_id = T4.plan_id WHERE T3.tenant_id = :tenant_id AND T3.account_id = T1.account_id AND LOWER(T3.status) = 'active' AND LOWER(T4.tier) = 'enterprise') LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

question: Which ten accounts have the largest unpaid balances on USD invoices currently marked open and due before 2026-09-30? Subtract successful payments attempted through 2026-09-30 from each invoice total, keep only invoices with a positive remaining balance, and show account name, industry and balance rounded to two decimals. Include accounts with no recorded industry and break ties by account ID.
gold_sql: WITH cte1 AS (SELECT T1.invoice_id, SUM(T1.amount / 100.0) AS c1 FROM payments AS T1 WHERE T1.tenant_id = :tenant_id AND LOWER(T1.status) = 'succeeded' AND T1.paid_at < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY T1.invoice_id), cte2 AS (SELECT T2.account_id, T2.total_amount - COALESCE(T3.c1, 0) AS c1 FROM invoices AS T2 LEFT JOIN cte1 AS T3 ON T2.invoice_id = T3.invoice_id WHERE T2.tenant_id = :tenant_id AND LOWER(T2.currency_code) = 'usd' AND LOWER(T2.status) = 'open' AND CASE WHEN INSTR(T2.due_date, '/') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(T2.due_date, 7, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(T2.due_date, 1, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(T2.due_date, 4, 2) ELSE T2.due_date END < '2026-09-30') SELECT T4.name, T5.name, ROUND(SUM(T6.c1), 2) AS c1 FROM accounts AS T4 LEFT JOIN industries AS T5 ON T4.industry_id = T5.industry_id JOIN cte2 AS T6 ON T4.account_id = T6.account_id WHERE T4.tenant_id = :tenant_id AND T6.c1 > 0 GROUP BY T4.account_id, T4.name, T5.name ORDER BY SUM(T6.c1) DESC, T4.account_id ASC LIMIT 10 OFFSET 0

question: Which five sales reps had the highest average number of logged calls per deal among deals they actually won in 2025? Count only calls linked to each deal between its creation and actual close, including won deals with no calls as zero. Show rep name, team, won-deal count and average calls rounded to two decimals; break ties by user ID.
gold_sql: WITH cte1 AS (SELECT T1.deal_id, T1.owner_user_id, COUNT(T2.activity_id) AS c1 FROM deals AS T1 LEFT JOIN activities AS T2 ON T2.deal_id = T1.deal_id AND T2.tenant_id = :tenant_id AND LOWER(T2.activity_type) = 'call' AND T2.occurred_at >= T1.created_at AND T2.occurred_at <= T1.closed_at WHERE T1.tenant_id = :tenant_id AND LOWER(T1.stage) = 'closed_won' AND T1.closed_at >= '2025-01-01' AND T1.closed_at < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY T1.deal_id, T1.owner_user_id) SELECT T1.full_name, T3.name, COUNT(*) AS c1, ROUND(AVG(T2.c1), 2) AS c2 FROM users AS T1 JOIN cte1 AS T2 ON T2.owner_user_id = T1.user_id LEFT JOIN teams AS T3 ON T3.team_id = T1.team_id AND T3.tenant_id = :tenant_id WHERE T1.tenant_id = :tenant_id AND LOWER(T1.role) = 'sales_rep' GROUP BY T1.user_id, T1.full_name, T3.name ORDER BY AVG(T2.c1) DESC, T1.user_id ASC LIMIT 5

question: How many subscriptions started in 2025 from deals owned by Sales East reps had their first non-void invoice paid in full within 30 days of issue? Identify the first invoice by issue date, breaking ties by invoice ID, and compare its total with successful payments attempted from its issue date through 30 calendar days afterward.
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS c1 FROM subscriptions AS T1 JOIN deals AS T2 ON T2.deal_id = T1.deal_id AND T2.tenant_id = :tenant_id JOIN users AS T3 ON T3.user_id = T2.owner_user_id AND T3.tenant_id = :tenant_id JOIN teams AS T4 ON T4.team_id = T3.team_id AND T4.tenant_id = :tenant_id WHERE T1.tenant_id = :tenant_id AND T1.started_at >= '2025-01-01' AND T1.started_at < '2026-01-01' AND LOWER(T3.role) = 'sales_rep' AND LOWER(T4.name) = 'sales east' AND EXISTS(SELECT T5.invoice_id FROM invoices AS T5 WHERE T5.tenant_id = :tenant_id AND T5.subscription_id = T1.subscription_id AND LOWER(T5.status) <> 'void' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT T6.invoice_id FROM invoices AS T6 WHERE T6.tenant_id = :tenant_id AND T6.subscription_id = T1.subscription_id AND LOWER(T6.status) <> 'void' AND (T6.issued_at < T5.issued_at OR (T6.issued_at = T5.issued_at AND T6.invoice_id < T5.invoice_id))) AND COALESCE((SELECT SUM(T7.amount) / 100.0 FROM payments AS T7 WHERE T7.tenant_id = :tenant_id AND T7.invoice_id = T5.invoice_id AND LOWER(T7.status) = 'succeeded' AND DATE(T7.paid_at) >= T5.issued_at AND DATE(T7.paid_at) <= DATE(T5.issued_at, '+30 days')), 0) >= T5.total_amount) LIMIT 100

question: Which 10 deals created in 2026 had a value in USD greater than the average USD value of all other deals for the same account, regardless of when those other deals were created? Exclude accounts with no other deals. Show deal names, account names and deal values in USD rounded to two decimals, using our fixed reporting exchange rates. Order by USD deal value descending, then deal ID.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.name, T2.name, ROUND(T1.amount * T3.usd_rate, 2) AS c1 FROM deals AS T1 JOIN accounts AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id AND T2.tenant_id = :tenant_id JOIN currencies AS T3 ON T1.currency_code = T3.currency_code WHERE T1.tenant_id = :tenant_id AND T1.created_at >= '2026-01-01' AND T1.created_at < '2027-01-01' AND T1.amount * T3.usd_rate > (SELECT AVG(T4.amount * T5.usd_rate) FROM deals AS T4 JOIN currencies AS T5 ON T4.currency_code = T5.currency_code WHERE T4.tenant_id = :tenant_id AND T4.account_id = T1.account_id AND T4.deal_id <> T1.deal_id) ORDER BY T1.amount * T3.usd_rate DESC, T1.deal_id LIMIT 10

question: How many customer accounts have at least one invoice issued in 2025 and every invoice they were issued that year is marked paid? Treat customer status without regard to capitalization, and let any void or written-off invoice disqualify an account.
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accounts AS T1 WHERE T1.tenant_id = :tenant_id AND LOWER(T1.lifecycle_stage) = 'customer' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM invoices AS T2 WHERE T2.tenant_id = :tenant_id AND T2.account_id = T1.account_id AND T2.issued_at >= '2025-01-01' AND T2.issued_at < '2026-01-01') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM invoices AS T3 WHERE T3.tenant_id = :tenant_id AND T3.account_id = T1.account_id AND T3.issued_at >= '2025-01-01' AND T3.issued_at < '2026-01-01' AND (LOWER(T3.status) <> 'paid' OR T3.status IS NULL)) LIMIT 100

question: Which 10 accounts have more contacts with no recorded email address than the average number of such contacts across all our accounts, including accounts with zero? Show account names and missing-email contact counts, ordered by count descending, then account ID.
gold_sql: WITH cte1 AS (SELECT T1.account_id, T1.name, COUNT(T2.contact_id) AS c1 FROM accounts AS T1 LEFT JOIN contacts AS T2 ON T2.account_id = T1.account_id AND T2.tenant_id = :tenant_id AND T2.email IS NULL WHERE T1.tenant_id = :tenant_id GROUP BY T1.account_id, T1.name) SELECT T1.name, T1.c1 FROM cte1 AS T1 WHERE T1.c1 > (SELECT AVG(T2.c1) FROM cte1 AS T2) ORDER BY T1.c1 DESC, T1.account_id LIMIT 10

question: Which 10 active subscriptions have more seats than the average across active subscriptions on the same plan? Show subscription IDs, account names, plan names and seat counts, ordered by seats descending, then subscription ID.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.subscription_id, T2.name AS c1, T3.name AS c2, T1.seats FROM subscriptions AS T1 JOIN accounts AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id AND T2.tenant_id = :tenant_id JOIN plans AS T3 ON T1.plan_id = T3.plan_id WHERE T1.tenant_id = :tenant_id AND LOWER(T1.status) = 'active' AND T1.seats > (SELECT AVG(T4.seats) FROM subscriptions AS T4 WHERE T4.tenant_id = :tenant_id AND LOWER(T4.status) = 'active' AND T4.plan_id = T1.plan_id) ORDER BY T1.seats DESC, T1.subscription_id LIMIT 10

question: Which 10 GBP invoices issued in 2025 had a combined negative line-item value whose absolute amount exceeded the average absolute negative line-item total among GBP invoices issued that year with at least one negative line? Show invoice numbers and absolute negative line-item totals in GBP rounded to two decimals, ordered by that total descending, then invoice ID.
gold_sql: WITH cte1 AS (SELECT T1.invoice_id, T1.invoice_number, ABS(SUM(T2.line_total)) AS c1 FROM invoices AS T1 JOIN invoice_line_items AS T2 ON T2.invoice_id = T1.invoice_id AND T2.tenant_id = :tenant_id WHERE T1.tenant_id = :tenant_id AND LOWER(T1.currency_code) = 'gbp' AND T1.issued_at >= '2025-01-01' AND T1.issued_at < '2026-01-01' AND T2.line_total < 0 GROUP BY T1.invoice_id, T1.invoice_number) SELECT T3.invoice_number, ROUND(T3.c1, 2) AS c2 FROM cte1 AS T3 WHERE T3.c1 > (SELECT AVG(T4.c1) FROM cte1 AS T4) ORDER BY T3.c1 DESC, T3.invoice_id LIMIT 10

question: Which 10 accounts had successful GBP payments collected in 2025 totaling more than the average across accounts with at least one successful GBP payment that year? Show account names and collected amounts in pounds rounded to two decimals, ordered by collected amount descending, then account ID.
gold_sql: WITH cte1 AS (SELECT T1.account_id, T1.name, SUM(T3.amount / 100.0) AS c1 FROM accounts AS T1 JOIN invoices AS T2 ON T2.account_id = T1.account_id AND T2.tenant_id = :tenant_id JOIN payments AS T3 ON T3.invoice_id = T2.invoice_id AND T3.tenant_id = :tenant_id WHERE T1.tenant_id = :tenant_id AND LOWER(T3.status) = 'succeeded' AND LOWER(T3.currency_code) = 'gbp' AND T3.paid_at >= '2025-01-01' AND T3.paid_at < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY T1.account_id, T1.name) SELECT T1.name, ROUND(T1.c1, 2) AS c1 FROM cte1 AS T1 WHERE T1.c1 > (SELECT AVG(T2.c1) FROM cte1 AS T2) ORDER BY T1.c1 DESC, T1.account_id LIMIT 10

question: Which 10 support agents had an average resolution time for tickets opened in 2025 greater than the overall average across all resolved tickets opened that year? Include only tickets with a recorded resolution time and only agents with at least five such tickets. Show agent names, ticket counts and average resolution hours rounded to two decimals, ordered by average hours descending, then user ID.
gold_sql: WITH cte1 AS (SELECT T1.owner_user_id AS c1, (JULIANDAY(T1.resolved_at) - JULIANDAY(T1.opened_at)) * 24.0 AS c2 FROM tickets AS T1 WHERE T1.tenant_id = :tenant_id AND DATE(T1.opened_at) >= '2025-01-01' AND DATE(T1.opened_at) < '2026-01-01' AND T1.resolved_at IS NOT NULL) SELECT T1.full_name, COUNT(*) AS c1, ROUND(AVG(T2.c2), 2) AS c2 FROM users AS T1 JOIN cte1 AS T2 ON T2.c1 = T1.user_id WHERE T1.tenant_id = :tenant_id AND LOWER(T1.role) = 'support_agent' GROUP BY T1.user_id, T1.full_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 AND AVG(T2.c2) > (SELECT AVG(T3.c2) FROM cte1 AS T3) ORDER BY AVG(T2.c2) DESC, T1.user_id LIMIT 10

question: Which 10 accounts had the most successful payment receipts in USD during 2025? Show each account's total converted using the fixed reporting rates, rounded to two decimals, and break ties by account ID.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.name, ROUND(SUM(T3.amount / 100.0 * T4.usd_rate), 2) AS c1 FROM accounts AS T1 JOIN invoices AS T2 ON T2.account_id = T1.account_id AND T2.tenant_id = :tenant_id JOIN payments AS T3 ON T3.invoice_id = T2.invoice_id AND T3.tenant_id = :tenant_id JOIN currencies AS T4 ON T4.currency_code = T3.currency_code WHERE T1.tenant_id = :tenant_id AND LOWER(T3.status) = 'succeeded' AND T3.paid_at >= '2025-01-01' AND T3.paid_at < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY T1.account_id, T1.name ORDER BY SUM(T3.amount / 100.0 * T4.usd_rate) DESC, T1.account_id ASC LIMIT 10 OFFSET 0

question: Which 10 accounts have more contacts than the average across all our accounts, including accounts with no contacts? Show the contact count, highest first, breaking ties by account ID.
gold_sql: WITH cte1 AS (SELECT T1.account_id, T1.name, COUNT(T2.contact_id) AS c1 FROM accounts AS T1 LEFT JOIN contacts AS T2 ON T2.account_id = T1.account_id AND T2.tenant_id = :tenant_id WHERE T1.tenant_id = :tenant_id GROUP BY T1.account_id, T1.name) SELECT T1.name, T1.c1 FROM cte1 AS T1 WHERE T1.c1 > (SELECT AVG(T2.c1) FROM cte1 AS T2) ORDER BY T1.c1 DESC, T1.account_id ASC LIMIT 10 OFFSET 0

question: For each Sales East rep who owns at least one deal actually closed in 2025, what percentage of those deals were won? Include inactive reps, round percentages to two decimals, and show the 10 highest percentages, breaking ties by user ID.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.full_name, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(T3.stage) = 'closed_won' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS c1 FROM users AS T1 JOIN teams AS T2 ON T1.team_id = T2.team_id AND T2.tenant_id = :tenant_id JOIN deals AS T3 ON T3.owner_user_id = T1.user_id AND T3.tenant_id = :tenant_id WHERE T1.tenant_id = :tenant_id AND LOWER(T2.name) = 'sales east' AND LOWER(T1.role) = 'sales_rep' AND LOWER(T3.stage) IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost') AND T3.closed_at >= '2025-01-01' AND T3.closed_at < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY T1.user_id, T1.full_name ORDER BY c1 DESC, T1.user_id ASC LIMIT 10

question: Which 10 accounts had the longest average support resolution time for tickets opened in 2025 and resolved by 2026-09-30? Show the average in hours, rounded to two decimals, highest first, breaking ties by account ID.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.name, ROUND(AVG((JULIANDAY(T2.resolved_at) - JULIANDAY(T2.opened_at)) * 24.0), 2) AS c1 FROM accounts AS T1 JOIN tickets AS T2 ON T2.account_id = T1.account_id AND T2.tenant_id = :tenant_id WHERE T1.tenant_id = :tenant_id AND JULIANDAY(T2.opened_at) >= JULIANDAY('2025-01-01') AND JULIANDAY(T2.opened_at) < JULIANDAY('2026-01-01') AND JULIANDAY(T2.resolved_at) < JULIANDAY('2026-10-01') GROUP BY T1.account_id, T1.name ORDER BY AVG((JULIANDAY(T2.resolved_at) - JULIANDAY(T2.opened_at)) * 24.0) DESC, T1.account_id ASC LIMIT 10

question: Which 10 accounts had the most calls logged in 2025 but no meetings logged in 2025? Show the call count, highest first, breaking ties by account ID.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.name, COUNT(*) AS c1 FROM accounts AS T1 JOIN activities AS T2 ON T2.account_id = T1.account_id AND T2.tenant_id = :tenant_id WHERE T1.tenant_id = :tenant_id AND LOWER(T2.activity_type) = 'call' AND T2.occurred_at >= '2025-01-01' AND T2.occurred_at < '2026-01-01' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM activities AS T3 WHERE T3.tenant_id = :tenant_id AND T3.account_id = T1.account_id AND LOWER(T3.activity_type) = 'meeting' AND T3.occurred_at >= '2025-01-01' AND T3.occurred_at < '2026-01-01') GROUP BY T1.account_id, T1.name ORDER BY c1 DESC, T1.account_id ASC LIMIT 10

question: Which 10 accounts had a total value of deals won in 2025 above the average among accounts with at least one deal won that year? gold_sql: WITH cte1 AS (SELECT T1.account_id, T1.name, SUM(T2.amount * T3.usd_rate) AS c1 FROM accounts AS T1 JOIN deals AS T2 ON T2.account_id = T1.account_id AND T2.tenant_id = :tenant_id JOIN currencies AS T3 ON T3.currency_code = T2.currency_code WHERE T1.tenant_id = :tenant_id AND LOWER(T2.stage) = 'closed_won' AND T2.closed_at >= '2025-01-01' AND T2.closed_at < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY T1.account_id, T1.name) SELECT T1.name, ROUND(T1.c1, 2) AS c1 FROM cte1 AS T1 WHERE T1.c1 > (SELECT AVG(T2.c1) AS c1 FROM cte1 AS T2) ORDER BY T1.c1 DESC, T1.account_id ASC LIMIT 10 OFFSET 0

question: How many calls, meetings and demos did Sales East and Sales West log in Q2 2026, by team and activity type? Include the total recorded duration in minutes.
gold_sql: SELECT T3.name, LOWER(T1.activity_type) AS c1, COUNT(*) AS c2, SUM(T1.duration_minutes) AS c3 FROM activities AS T1 JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.owner_user_id = T2.user_id AND T2.tenant_id = :tenant_id JOIN teams AS T3 ON T2.team_id = T3.team_id AND T3.tenant_id = :tenant_id WHERE T1.tenant_id = :tenant_id AND LOWER(T3.name) IN ('sales east', 'sales west') AND LOWER(T1.activity_type) IN ('call', 'meeting', 'demo') AND T1.occurred_at >= '2026-04-01' AND T1.occurred_at < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY T3.name, LOWER(T1.activity_type) ORDER BY T3.name, LOWER(T1.activity_type) LIMIT 100

question: How many active sales reps, support agents and customer success managers are in each team, broken down by role? Show only team-and-role groups with at least two people.

question: For Donald Benitez's open deals, what are the total deal value and probability-weighted value by currency, rounded to two decimals? Exclude deals without a win probability from both totals.
